summary.text: Bo Mitchell is a Democratic member of the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 50, where he has served since 2012, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Mitchell is the only candidate listed for the District 50 general election.

paragraphs.text: Bo Mitchell received a B.A. in political science from David Lipscomb University and a J.D. from Nashville School of Law.
He has worked as a director of sales and employee benefits.
Mitchell has represented District 50 in the Tennessee House since 2012.
In the 2023–2024 session he was assigned to the Health and Insurance committees.
His 2016 campaign website, as quoted by Ballotpedia, listed roads and infrastructure, schools, health care, and local control for Nashville as issues.
